# GitContextGen

> High-Fidelity Codebase AI Context Engine & Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Sonnet 5, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Replit & Windsurf.

GitContextGen (https://repopulse-ai.singhnaveen360.workers.dev) solves AI context drift and hallucinations by parsing repository file trees, package manifests, build scripts, and security boundaries to synthesize zero-drift "Floor Plan" specifications for autonomous AI coding agents.

## Core Capabilities
- **Universal AGENT_README.md & AGENTS.md Generator**: Evidence-backed AI intelligence dossier with adaptive single-file vs multi-agent subagent delegation.
- **CLAUDE.md & Sonnet 5 Context Generator**: Native memory configuration for Claude Code and Anthropic models.
- **.cursorrules Exporter**: System prompt rules and architectural constraints for Cursor IDE.
- **GitHub Copilot Instructions**: Workspace directives for GitHub Copilot.
- **replit.md Blueprint**: Project layout and run commands for Replit Agent.
- **Google OSV.dev CVE Scanning**: Real-time batch vulnerability detection for npm, PyPI, Crates.io, and Go dependencies.
- **Kroki Architecture Visualizer**: Vector SVG/PNG Mermaid.js architecture diagrams for README embedding.
- **QuickChart Radar Scorecards**: 5-axis agent readiness metrics visualizing Setup, Test, Architecture, Boundary Safety, and Multi-Agent coverage.
- **SPDX License Compliance**: Automated copyright and open-source license guardrail mapping.

## Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
AI coding assistants can connect directly over `stdio` without copying large markdown files:
```bash
npx -y gitcontextgen-mcp
```

### Available MCP Tools
- `gitcontextgen_analyze`: Analyzes local directories or remote GitHub repos for file trees, dependencies, scripts, and entry points.
- `gitcontextgen_get_rules`: Generates formatted context rules (AGENT_README.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions, universal AGENTS.md).
- `gitcontextgen_get_architecture`: Produces Mermaid.js diagrams and Kroki SVG/PNG links for repository architecture.
- `gitcontextgen_get_changelog`: Generates audience-tailored release notes from git commit history.
